long_biography.plain_text:
Lias ‘Jeff’ Steen won the Producer’s Vision Award at the Sun Valley Film Festival for Running with Beto in 2019. His production work extends beyond cinema: he joined the team developing the stage adaptation of Rear Window and became lead producer of the podcast Pack One Bag. His later film credits include an executive producer role on Hard Twist.

Steen studied agricultural economics at Texas A&M before earning a law degree from South Texas College of Law. He has maintained ties to education and local history, serving as chairman of Texas A&M’s alumni association in 2025 and chairing the Chisholm Trail Heritage Museum Endowment.
